Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODDesc

SetRawData

The SetRawData method assigns the specified raw data to this descriptor object; any previous data is deleted. 
void SetRawData (in ODByteArray data);
data
A byte array whose buffer contains the raw data to be stored.
SEE ALSO
The ODByteArray type (page 877).
"Returning Tokens" on page 428 in OpenDoc Programmer's Guide.
